prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption was helpful in one test (+7.0%), though a second attempt showed no clear effect.
Introducing a new flow on home (+8.6%) and specific hints for adoption (+5.4%) and path decisions (+3.1%) were helpful.
Streamlining path selection copy hurt performance (-4.7%), and sign-in restore hints also hurt performance (-5.8%).
Layout updates, background notifications, wait info, tutorial screens, incentives, and other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too optimistic, overestimating expected gains for most tests.
Predictions were too low for the winning home new flow (+1.0% predicted vs +8.6% measured) and path decision hint (+0.5% predicted vs +3.1% measured).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, incentive: +0.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: +2.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -4.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: +1.8% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, new_flow: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -0.5% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: +5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +4.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.6% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.6% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -5.8% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.6% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.8%

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Spotlight Path Selection Experience: Redesign the choose_path screen layout to a spotlight layout that highlights key companion traits and path expectations. (why: Path selection drop-off is 23.9% with a high mean completion time of 514s; spotlighting choices helps users decide quickly.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Style Preference Showcase Screen: Introduce a dedicated style selection screen before pick_friend to let users preview visual archetypes before adopting. (why: Adoption stage drops off significantly to 64.2% and support received emails about custom pets failing or looking wrong.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Companion Arrival Readiness Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a checklist activity flow where users configure desktop pet behavior preferences during loading. (why: The waiting home step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s); engaging users in setup reduces perceived wait drop-off.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Quick Control Showcase: Redesign home_intro into a split layout screen showcasing essential desktop controls for summoning, hiding, and talking to the pet. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and multiple support emails complained of confusion over how to control or summon pets post-setup.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Identity Security Hint: Add an explicit security hint on sign_in explaining that account creation protects custom pets from being reset or lost. (why: The #1 support theme (8 emails) was pets missing or reset after signing in again, making persistence assurances critical.)
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Generation Photo Quality Hint: Display a target quality photo framing tip on upload_photos to ensure custom pet photo generation succeeds on the first attempt. (why: Users reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results; clear input guidance prevents processing failures.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Card Carousel Story Intro Layout: Switch the onboarding story screen to a carousel layout illustrating pet features and interactions. (why: First step drop-off is 23.9%; dynamic visual card layouts build early emotional engagement before decision steps.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Companion Tray Shortcut Hint: Add a hint on home_intro clarifying how to access the pet from the desktop system tray when minimized. (why: Support tickets highlight user confusion regarding missing desktop pets and unresponsiveness after completing setup.)
